ftb.guhs_techniek.q.einde2_trap5_machine: The &6Order Guh&r works at an &6Order Counter&r next to your Tinker Machines. Order, and he takes everything out of the bank, runs the machines and brings the receipt.
The Order Guh
A turning Enderguh Wheel and a glowing Comet Core, both in your own net.
New Sources
&6Air Blower&r, &6Water Bearer&r, &6Crust Pusher&r and &6Fire Basket&r: let each of them do its thing.
The Four Elements
A &5Wahoog Enderguh&r flies rounds in a giant wheel: 50 chonk power. One per setup counts.
The Enderguh Wheel
Tell the Mechanist Guh. For the first time in a hundred years he finishes something: a diploma, for you. And he has one more big plan...
All Done
The shard of the nibble comet lies by the duel square of the Fire Nation Capital, only for you. The &6Comet Core&r: 500 chonk power, the strongest source so far.
A Little Tail of the Comet
A &6Nibble Gate Tube&r sends what goes in to its buddy, even in another dimension.
Mail Through the Gate
A &6Guh Terminal&r is a little window into your Bank Guh. Link it with the &6Bank Key&r. Search, sort, take, put in: with the rules of your bank.
Your Bank, Everywhere
Your own network of &6Home Gates&r. Choose where you jump to; your guhs on a lead and your mount come along.
Home in One Step
After the finale of the Guhvatar story the door of the workshop in the &dSouthern Air Temple&r opens. Talk to the &6Mechanist Guh&r: he gives you his &6Blueprint&r, for all the machines of tier 5.
The Workshop Opens
A &6Chonk Transmitter&r sends the chonk power of its net to &6Chonk Receivers&r within 32 blocks. Together they are one net: short anywhere = everything still.
Power Through the Air

"I, the Mechanist Guh, hereby declare that this Guhvatar has finished more than I ever did. Signed, with three wooden fingers."
quest.guhs.einde2_trap5_machines.werktui: All finished? Really all of it? Come on, come on, tell me!
Next to the workshop there is a building site. The Mechanist Guh has one more big plan...
The Blueprint stays in the crafting grid. Lost it? Sneak-click the Mechanist Guh for a new one.
Have a look at practice setup 1 in the workshop too.
A terminal also works in another dimension than your bank.
He makes intermediate products too, when there is a machine for them.
Both sides must be loaded and have chonk power.
Hold an item, open the gate and click Icon: that becomes its icon.
An Air Blower placed while you look down becomes a little lift.
The shard lies there only for you. Step on it to take it.
Here, I'll make the first one for you. The rest you tinker yourself, with my Blueprint.
You did it. Everything works. Nothing is half done. I need to sit down for a moment.
I used to build balloons that rained fire. I thought I would never make anything good again.
Here: a diploma. I finished it completely. My first finished thing in a hundred years. And an extra Home Gate, for the road.
Not finished yet, nyeg! Come back once you have brought the whole world back into balance. That takes a while, I know.
Project one: power through the air. A Chonk Transmitter sends the chonk power of its net to receivers nearby.
Put a Chonk Transmitter on your net and a Chonk Receiver within 32 blocks, with a machine on it. Short anywhere? Then everything stands still, as always.
Project two: your bank, everywhere. A Guh Terminal is a little window into your Bank Guh. No tablet, nyeg: a block.
Click your Bank Guh with the Bank Key and then the terminal. Give it chonk power, click it, and look: your bank!
Project three: the Order Guh. He works at an Order Counter next to your Tinker Machines, in an apron. A sweet apron.
Link the counter to your bank. Order at the counter or with the Order button of your terminal: he takes everything out of the bank and runs the machines.
Project four: mail through the gate. A Nibble Gate Tube has a teeny Nibble Gate. It took me six years. It was mostly the ears.
Sneak-click one tube, sneak-click the other, and they're buddies. Put something in: it comes out at the other one, even in another dimension.
Project five: home in one step. A Home Gate is yours alone, unless you let someone in. Put down as many as you like.
It charges with what your net has left over. The more gates you have, the more a jump costs. Your guhs on a lead jump along!
Project six: the four elements, in machines. Air, water, earth, fire. I once built them for the war. Now they do something sweet.
An Air Blower, a Water Bearer, a Crust Pusher and a Fire Basket. Let each of them do its thing once in your world.
Project seven: new sources. An Enderguh Wheel: a giant wheel in which a Wahoog Enderguh flies around. 50 chonk power!
And the shard of the nibble comet still lies by the duel square in the Fire Nation Capital. Pick it up and put it in your net. It's still glowing.
A machine with a sleeping snout has no chonk power. A surprised snout is full. A happy snout: all good!
A Chonk Receiver gives exactly what its net is short of. No more, no less. Tidy, nyeg.
The Comet Core is the strongest source so far. So far! I still have plans. Always.
My wooden fingers? Oh well. An experiment with a steam merry-go-round. It is still turning, somewhere.
You know what I love most about inventing? That something that didn't exist suddenly helps someone.
Ah! My workshop! Don't look at the mess, look at the possibilities. Mind those cogs, they bite.
For a hundred years I made things halfway. A wing without feathers, a stove without fire. I was waiting for someone to finish them.
Here, my Blueprint. Put it in every recipe of my machines: it just stays where it is. Every project leaves something working in YOUR world.
scene.guhs.einde2_trap5_machines_werkpla: Who's knocking on my door so chonkily? ...By all my cogs. The Guhvatar himself!
For a hundred years I tinkered with this door. It wasn't finished yet, nyeg. Today it is.
I used to build war balloons for the Fire Nation. I'm not proud of that. Really not.
Now that there is peace again, I want to make things nobody is afraid of. Come in! My ears are tingling already.
